subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: Should Gateway expose one shared degraded/reloading contract to `sessions.resolve` and Control UI during launchd plugin/config reloads, and what user-facing recovery behavior should be the default?
rationale: Current code has several partial mechanisms, but choosing whether session RPCs fail with retryable `UNAVAILABLE`, whether Control UI blocks/retries, and how launchd recovery is surfaced is product behavior rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Define shared degraded state
options.body: Make partial reload/readiness state authoritative across session RPCs and Control UI, with retryable errors or UI copy that tells users the gateway is reloading and to retry shortly.

options.title: Land only the WebChat notice subset
options.body: Treat the related WebChat unresumable-notice work as sufficient for now and leave broader readiness/session semantics unchanged.

options.title: Document as operator-maintenance risk
options.body: Keep live plugin/config maintenance as an advanced unsupported path and document doctor/restart recovery instead of changing runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Define shared degraded state
recommendation.body: Make partial reload/readiness state authoritative across session RPCs and Control UI, with retryable errors or UI copy that tells users the gateway is reloading and to retry shortly.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway startup, method availability, reload behavior, and Control UI-visible semantics where this owner has repeated adjacent history.
